local.title: Local installation
local.description: Your data stays on this computer. Nothing is sent to us.

welcome.subtitle: Desktop chat with agents, documents and code.
welcome.duration: Installation takes less than a minute.

models.title: Your models
models.description: OpenCode, OpenAI and Anthropic in one place.

local.title: Local-first
local.description: Conversations and files stay on your computer.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: Library, code, terminal and skills included.

updates.title: Easy updates
updates.description: Run the new installer whenever you want.

welcome.keepData: Updating keeps your conversations, files, settings and API keys.
welcome.hint: By continuing, you can choose where and for whom to install.

scope.title: Who are we installing for?
scope.description: Choose the scope. The per-user option does not require administrator; the option for everyone makes Zylara available to any account on this computer.

user.title: Just for me
user.description: Installs to {{path}}. Does not require administrator permission.

machine.title: For all users
machine.description: Installs to {{path}}. Windows will ask for administrator permission.

scope.elevateWarning: If you continue, the installer will reopen with administrator permissions to create shortcuts and register the app for everyone.

conflicting.title: An installation already exists in another scope.
conflicting.description: {{scope}} in {{path}} (v{{version}}). Remove that installation before continuing.

scope.hint: You can change the folder in the next step.

location.title: Where to install?
location.description: The folder will be created if it does not exist yet. Zylara needs a local drive for the database and checkpoints.
location.label: Installation folder
location.adminWarning: The folder in Program Files requires administrator.
location.hint: Your conversation data is kept separate from the application folder.

options.title: Adjust the details
options.descriptionUpdate: Zylara {{version}} will be installed over version {{existingVersion}}. Your data will be preserved.
options.description: Choose how Zylara should appear in Windows. You can change the shortcuts later in the installation folder.

conflicting.title: Another Zylara installation exists.
conflicting.description: {{scope}} in {{path}} (v{{version}}). Remove that installation before continuing.

running.title: Zylara is open
running.description: Close the application before continuing to avoid locked files.

desktopShortcut.title: Desktop shortcut
desktopShortcut.description: Creates a shortcut to open Zylara.

startMenuShortcut.title: Start menu shortcut
startMenuShortcut.description: Adds Zylara to the Start menu and Windows search.

launchAfterInstall.title: Open Zylara when finished
launchAfterInstall.description: Starts the application as soon as installation ends.

options.hintElevate: When installing, Windows will ask for administrator permission.
options.hintDefault: Installation does not remove or change your existing conversations.

progress.title: Installing Zylara
progress.description: Keep this window open. The installer is applying the changes safely.
progress.hint: You can cancel before the file copy starts.

finish.descriptionUninstallPurge: The application and user data were removed from this computer.
finish.descriptionUninstall: The application was removed. Your conversations, files and settings were preserved.
finish.descriptionLaunched: Zylara was installed and is already open. Nice work!
finish.descriptionDone: Zylara is ready to use. You can open it now or from the desktop.

uninstall.title: Remove Zylara?
uninstall.description: The application will be removed from this computer. You can choose whether conversations, files and settings should also be deleted.

purge.label: Also remove my data
purge.description: Deletes conversations, attachments, artifacts, settings and API keys saved on this computer. This action cannot be undone.

uninstall.purgeWarning: API keys will be deleted. You will need to configure them again if you reinstall Zylara.
uninstall.infoConfirm: Confirm again to delete the application and all data for the current user. This action is permanent.
uninstall.infoNext: In the next step you confirm the data removal. Your files are still protected until then.
uninstall.infoDefault: Your conversations, files and settings are kept by default.
uninstall.hint: Removing the application does not affect other accounts on this computer.

errorScreen.title: Could not install
errorScreen.description: The operation was interrupted. See the details below and try again.
errorScreen.problem: The installer ran into a problem
errorScreen.hint: The full log is in the Windows temporary folder.

errors.notInstalled: Zylara is not installed for this user.

pathError.absolute: Use an absolute path on a local drive, such as C:\Program Files\Zylara.
pathError.root: Choose a folder inside the drive, not the root.
